row.evidence: Thoropass's help centre says it "uses the SCIM 2.0 API" at https://api.thoropass.com/scim/v2 with a key from Customer Success, and its site says "Organizations receive a tailored quote".
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans; laika.com/heylaika.com redirect to Thoropass (Laika Compliance, LLC dba Thoropass Assurance). SCIM 2.0 (Okta custom SCIM app and Entra; Google not supported) needs SSO configured first and an API key from Customer Success; deprovisioning deactivates the user. The Okta and Entra catalogue apps are SAML SSO (+JIT) only; SCIM runs against the generic endpoint. Delete behaviour, attributes beyond userName and seat effects are not documented. No public user-management API.

plans.name: Thoropass (tailored quote)
plans.notes: Pricing bundles software and audit services; no public tiers.

auth.token_source: API key issued on request by the Thoropass Customer Success representative
auth.notes: Entra uses it as the Secret Token; Okta sends it as an HTTP Header Authorization value.

operations.notes: Okta setup enables Push New Users, Push Profile Updates and Push Groups; HTTP methods for updates are not documented.

limitations.text: Google Workspace cannot provision over SCIM (vendor says Google does not support SCIM 2.0).
Okta SCIM works only with a SCIM-installed (custom) app, not the Okta catalogue app.
Azure SCIM settings may be missing on the gallery app; the vendor says to reconnect with standard SAML and follow the Okta (universal) steps.
SCIM token must be requested from Customer Success; no self-serve token.

user_api.notes: No public user-management API reference found; the only documented API key is the one Customer Success issues for SCIM.

okta.notes: Catalogue app is SAML; SCIM only through a custom SCIM app per vendor.

entra.notes: Microsoft tutorial covers SSO + JIT only; vendor documents adding its SCIM URL under the gallery app's Provisioning tab, which may be unavailable.

google.notes: Vendor says Google Workspace SCIM is not supported.

fallbacks.other_sync: HR integrations feed the People (employee) table, separate from app users
